# The Be Book

BeOS's API reference (ACCESS Co., Ltd., 2008 edition, as Haiku ships it
in its `be_book` package), as Markdown, for reading and grepping beside
the code when deciding how Tabula should do something. Start at
[INDEX.md](INDEX.md) (every page, by title) or [index.md](index.md).
Useful places: [DragAndDrop.md](DragAndDrop.md), [BView.md](BView.md),
[BMessage.md](BMessage.md), [BWindow.md](BWindow.md), the Tracker-facing
pages ([BNodeInfo.md](BNodeInfo.md), [TheStorageKit_Overview.md](TheStorageKit_Overview.md)).

Made by [convert.py](convert.py) from `bebook_20081026.zip`, the source
of HaikuPorts' `haiku-data/be_book` recipe (sha256 `8bd4836744c2…7a28`).
Licence: CC BY-NC-ND 3.0, © ACCESS Co., Ltd. In-page `#anchors` aren't
kept, so links land at the top of the page.
